verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents scheduling of backups, with daily default backups plus manual backups (docs-12, docs-33). It also describes agents reviewing Insights and opening performance PRs 'on a recurring schedule' via its MCP server (docs-31, docs-42). However, that recurring agent workflow appears to depend on an external agent's scheduler, and backups are the only first-party scheduled job shown. Missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduler for recurring user-defined jobs or workflows (e.g., cron or SQL jobs), first-party scheduling of the agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
